claims.statement: The proposed sufficient condition tau(T) >= 7 for every eligible third-shell tree is false: the n=24, p=10 six-arm tree with arm leaf counts (2,3,3,3,3,3) has tau(T)=6.
claims.scope: One exact eligible ordinary tree at n=2p+4, p=10. This refutes the cover-threshold shortcut only; its selected pointwise terms and full aggregate are negative.
claims.reason: retained: the labeled witness is an eligible ordinary tree with tau=6, certified by a six-center vertex cover and six disjoint edges; independent exact arithmetic verifies all original leaves are selected and S=-122805. It refutes the stated tau>=7 shortcut, not the pointwise or primary aggregate claim.

claims.statement: In the enumerated six-arm rooted family at n=2p+4 for p=10..13, the exact sorted-multiset census has one eligible row at p=10 and none at p=11,12,13; the eligible p=10 row has no positive selected pointwise term.
claims.scope: Only root-plus-six-centers trees with pendant-leaf counts d_i >= 0 and sum d_i=2p-3; finite census of 163, 235, 331, and 454 sorted multisets respectively.
claims.reason: retained: source replay and independent combinations-with-replacement enumeration give the stated finite profile counts and eligibility results; the only eligible profile has 17 selected leaves, all local terms negative, and S=-122805. The conclusion is bounded to this family and range.

limitations: The six-arm profile census covers only the specified root-plus-six-centers family for p=10 through 13.
The exact tau=6 witness refutes the tau>=7 shortcut only; it has negative pointwise terms and negative full selected sum.
No general third-shell pointwise theorem, low-cover replacement inequality, or proof or refutation of the primary selected aggregate is obtained.
The producer replay is supplemented by an independent generic induced-subgraph recurrence and a separate profile enumeration; no imported theorem or formal proof is supplied.
